mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, company, position, start_date, end_date, is_current, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM work_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, start_date DESC
SELECT id, user_id, company, position, start_date, end_date, is_current, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM work_experiences WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_experiences (user_id, company, position, start_date, end_date, is_current, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{company}, #{position}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{isCurrent}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE work_experiences SET company = #{company}, position = #{position}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, is_current = #{isCurrent}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
